name: Obsidian Hart Dragon - Adult
description: Adult Obsidian Hart is a neutral-leaning firmament intelligent true dragon with black star-speckled scales, antlers, and wing-forelimbs. It seeks to test endurance by taking away comfort and shelter. At this age it is a commanding force in its territory.

attacks.name: Antler and Talon
attacks.description: The dragon strikes one target within Very Close range with its primary natural weapons.

abilities.name: Relentless (3)
abilities.description: The dragon can be spotlighted up to 3 times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

abilities.name: Hunter’s Darkness
abilities.description: While in darkness made by its breath, the dragon gains +2 Difficulty.

abilities.name: Starless Breath
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to exhale a cone reaching Close range. All enemies in the cone make an Agility Reaction Roll against Difficulty 18. On a failure, take 3d8+6 magic damage and ordinary flames and magical light in the target’s space go out until the dragon’s next spotlight. On a success, take half damage without the additional effect.

abilities.name: Antler Charge
abilities.description: Mark a Stress. Move up to Close range and make a standard attack against one target. On a success, deal 3d12+5 physical damage and knock it back to Close range.

abilities.name: No Easy Shelter
abilities.description: When a creature within Close range enters cover, mark a Stress to move into Very Close range of it. This movement grants no attack.

abilities.name: Roused Fury
abilities.description: Once per scene, immediately after the dragon marks half its total HP (round up), clear 1 Stress and move up to Close range. This movement does not grant an attack.
